scope: Float y positioning independent of anchor flow, including y above the anchor

implementation.wrap: square/tight/through floats are rendered at page content start with margin-top = y (clamped 0..864-height); text above and below wraps around them, independent of anchor flow
implementation.block: topAndBottom remains an in-flow block before the anchor and accepts negative margin-top = y - measured flow, so y can be above the anchor
implementation.overlay: behind/front remain absolute overlays at top = 96 + y, already independent of anchor

remaining: A paragraph crossing a topAndBottom y is moved as a whole to the nearest block boundary; it is not split mid-paragraph
VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
